## What this project is

This is `bench-fixture` — a tiny throwaway Node.js codebase (per `README.md`) used by `oncode/scripts/bench.mjs` as a realistic-but-small target for a benchmark. It's not a real product; it exists to give both arms of some benchmark comparison the same fixed codebase to explore/debug, including "unrelated" modules that add exploration cost and one intentionally planted bug.

## Structure

```
src/
